action_items.detail: The preview URL (goorin-inbox.preview.emergentagent.com) put up a Cloudflare challenge and returned HTTP 429 to automated runs. I moved settings-users-manage to localhost:3000, where it passed. There is no backend in this phase, so there was no backend test lane.

Checks were updated for the redesign: the preview state control is now driven with selectOption on the preview-state select. The sidebar check now expects the toggle under the Settings icon (collapsed), the toggle right-aligned on the Settings row (expanded) and a 160px centered wordmark. It no longer expects the old right-edge, mid-height tab.

checks.name: p5-branding-launcher
checks.evidence: 'Inherit from store theme' gives a computed panel font of Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif. 'Inter' gives 'Inter', system-ui. Switching back to inherit gives Georgia again. The launcher, offsets and badge all passed.

checks.name: p5-widget-settings-save-guard
checks.evidence: Desktop/tablet/mobile device buttons and 8 preview-state options found. Hex #AA2233 applied, and the save, discard and leave guard all passed.

checks.name: p5-messaging-display-csat
checks.evidence: Selecting the handoff, offline, greeting_bubble, prechat, active_chat and csat states with the select works.

checks.name: p5-install-theme-editor-embed
checks.evidence: Install flow, then theme editor embed off gives Disabled. Back link goes to /settings/widget#install.

checks.name: p5-access-states-tablet
checks.evidence: Horizontal overflow 0 at 1024 and 768. Agent sees the access-denied message.

checks.name: settings-routes-integrations
checks.evidence: Test connection shows 'Connection OK · 471ms'. Credentials are masked.

checks.name: settings-ai-form
checks.evidence: Save completes and the AI settings saved state shows. Slider focus ring is present.

checks.name: settings-users-manage
checks.evidence: Rows: Ava (you), Sam Okafor, Priya Shah (Invited). Passed on localhost; the preview URL returned 429 and a Cloudflare challenge.

checks.name: p5-sidebar-light-logos
checks.evidence: Collapsed: width 72, toggle centered under Settings, aria-expanded=false, badge at the icon's top-right. Expanded: width 240, no castle tile, wordmark 160px and centered, toggle on the Settings row.
